rules: Migration rows give the primary destination. Named symbol splits below have one authority per symbol; no second editable implementation.

splits.shared_rule: Accept caller-selected config/schema; no Writer import or autonomous model selection.
Only credential-safe transport/config status is common. Writer-specific policy stays caller-owned.
splits.preset_rule: One versioned data authority; caller explicitly selects compatible preset. Legacy constants generated/read from it, never hand-maintained duplicates.
splits.gate: C3 explicit permitted caller values override preset; existing env/env-file priority unchanged
